author: SeverinDiederichs
body: Update AdePT to v0.4.2, containing fixes needed for CMSSW, and G4HepEm to tag 20261028, which has a small Woodcock tracking speedup. Remove redundant compiler definitions from SCRAM, as AdePT now supplies them through the installed `AdePTBuildFlags.hh`.
